role: Executive Director, Board of Trustees of the Internal Improvement Trust Fund, Florida
stance_basis: letter explicitly states 'We have no objection to the statement and executive order 11644'
summary: Joel Kuperberg, as Executive Director of the Board of Trustees of the Internal Improvement Trust Fund, Florida, reviewed the draft environmental impact statement on ORV use on public lands and raised no objections to either the statement or Executive Order 11644. His letter was brief and supportive, and was noted by the state clearinghouse as one of the letters 'endorsing the proposal or offering no adverse comments.'
complaint_summary: Kuperberg states that the Trustees' staff reviewed the draft EIS and has no objection to the statement or Executive Order 11644, and encloses an American Motorcycle Association advertisement for interest.

statement.text:
The Trustees' staff has reviewed the draft environmental impact statement.
We have no objection to the statement and executive order 11644.
Enclosed for your interest is a merom copy of an advertisement placed by the American Motorcycle Association in the July issue of CYCLE.
